entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from network to UE.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where extended protocol configuration options are not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Network transmits protocol data to UE
entities.description: Network behavior of transmitting protocol data including configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

relations.description: Protocol configuration options IE is included when extended protocol configuration options are not supported.
When extended protocol configuration options are not supported, the network transmits protocol data to the UE using PCO IE.
